## Goal
`npx hkb` works for a stranger: the package publishes cleanly to npm under the name `hkb`, with provenance, a CI-gated release path, and a README that serves an adopter rather than this repo's own dogfooding history.

This is the demo track: decomposed via /kanban:decompose, executed by one claude-track session, every node a durable checkpoint.

## Out of scope (human steps after the track lands)
Creating the npm token (`npm token` → `gh secret set NPM_TOKEN`) and pushing the version tag that actually publishes — credentials and the release trigger stay with the operator.
title: Publish hkb to npm
